title: Common denominator addition respects represented sections
statement: Let k be a field, S=k[x0,x1] with its standard grading [def-sc-p1-standard], P=Proj S, G an O_P-module and M a Z-graded S-module with additive pieces M_z and S_n M_z contained in M_(n+z). Let phi_z be additive equivalences M_z -> Gamma(P,G tensor O_P(z)) for z>=0, compatible with homogeneous multiplication [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf]. For f in S_d, define Rel(x,s) to mean that some m>=0 and y in M_(m*d) satisfy x=y/f^m in M_f and that phi_(m*d)(y) restricts to multiplication of s by f^m on D+(f). For every degree d (including zero), all x,z in M_f and s,t in Gamma(D+(f),G), Rel(x,s) and Rel(z,t) imply Rel(x+z,s+t). No coherence, internal grading, negative-degree vanishing or positive-degree assumption is needed.

source.place: Proposition 0BXD, final paragraph; parent chart proof step 1

proof.text:
Take witnesses y/f^m and z/f^n. The numerator f^n*y+f^m*z is homogeneous
of degree (m+n)*d by graded scalar compatibility. LocalizedModule.mk_add_mk
identifies its fraction with the sum of the original fractions. Additivity
of phi and restriction, compatibility of phi with homogeneous multiplication,
and composition of twist multiplication identify its restriction with
f^(m+n)*(s+t). Thus this numerator and denominator witness the sum relation.
The calculation also holds for f=0 and for m or n zero.
